edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet saw.
verses.hebrew: הַמַּשָׂא אֲשֶׁר חָזָה חֲבַקּוּק הַנָּבִיא׃

verses.english: How long, YHWH, have I cried for help and You do not hear? I cry to You, “Violence!” and You do not save.
verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה יְהוָה שִׁוַּעְתִּי וְלֹא תִשְׁמָע אֶזְעַק אֵלֶיךָ חָמָס וְלֹא תוֹשִׁיעַ׃

verses.english: Why do You make me see wrongdoing, and why do You look upon misery? Destruction and violence are before me; strife arises and contention lifts itself up.
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תַרְאֵנִי אָוֶן וְעָמָל תַּבִּיט וְשֹׁד וְחָמָס לְנֶגְדִּי וַיְהִי רִיב וּמָדוֹן יִשָּׂא׃

verses.english: Therefore instruction grows numb, and justice never goes forth; the wicked surrounds the righteous, so justice goes forth twisted.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן תָּפוּג תּוֹרָה וְלֹא־יֵצֵא לָנֶצַח מִשְׁפָּט כִּי רָשָׁע מַכְתִּיר אֶת־הַצַּדִּיק עַל־כֵּן יֵצֵא מִשְׁפָּט מְעֻקָּל׃

verses.english: Look among the nations and observe; be utterly astonished! For a work is being done in your days that you would not believe if it were told.
verses.hebrew: רְאוּ בַגּוֹיִם וְהַבִּיטוּ וְהִתַּמְּהוּ תְּמָהוּ כִּי־פֹעַל פֹּעֵל בִּימֵיכֶם לֹא תַאֲמִינוּ כִּי יְסֻפָּר׃

verses.english: For look, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and impetuous nation, who traverse the breadth of the earth to possess dwellings not their own.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנְנִי מֵקִים אֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּים הַגּוֹי הַמַּר וְהַנִּמְהָר הַהוֹלֵךְ לְמֶרְחֲבֵי־אֶרֶץ לָרֶשֶׁת מִשְׁכָּנוֹת לֹּא־לוֹ׃

verses.english: Dreadful and fearsome are they; their judgment and dignity proceed from themselves.
verses.hebrew: אָיֹם וְנוֹרָא הוּא מִמֶּנּוּ מִשְׁפָּטוֹ וּשְׂאֵתוֹ יֵצֵא׃

verses.english: Their horses are swifter than leopards and fiercer than wolves at evening. Their horsemen spread out; their horsemen come from afar, flying like an eagle hastening to eat.
verses.hebrew: וְקַלּוּ מִנְּמֵרִים סוּסָיו וְחַדּוּ מִזְּאֵבֵי עֶרֶב וּפָשׁוּ פָּרָשָׁיו וּפָרָשָׁיו מֵרָחוֹק יָבֹאוּ יָעֻפוּ כְּנֶשֶׁר חָשׁ לֶאֱכוֹל׃

verses.english: All of them come for violence, their faces pressing eastward; they gather captives like sand.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלֹּה לְחָמָס יָבוֹא מְגַמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם קָדִימָה וַיֶּאֱסֹף כַּחוֹל שֶׁבִי׃

verses.english: They mock kings and make rulers a laughingstock. They laugh at every fortress, heap up earth and capture it.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא בַּמְּלָכִים יִתְקַלָּס וְרֹזְנִים מִשְׂחָק לוֹ הוּא לְכָל־מִבְצָר יִשְׂחָק וַיִּצְבֹּר עָפָר וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃

verses.english: Then they sweep on like wind and pass through, and incur guilt—those whose own strength is their god.
verses.hebrew: אָז חָלַף רוּחַ וַיַּעֲבֹר וְאָשֵׁם זוּ כֹחוֹ לֵאלֹהוֹ׃

verses.english: Are You not from of old, YHWH my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. YHWH, You appointed him for judgment; Rock, You established him for correction.
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא אַתָּה מִקֶּדֶם יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי קְדֹשִׁי לֹא נָמוּת יְהוָה לְמִשְׁפָּט שַׂמְתּוֹ וְצוּר לְהוֹכִיחַ יְסַדְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: Your eyes are too pure to see evil, and You cannot look upon misery. Why do You look upon the treacherous and remain silent when the wicked swallows someone more righteous than himself?
verses.hebrew: טְהוֹר עֵינַיִם מֵרְאוֹת רָע וְהַבִּיט אֶל־עָמָל לֹא תוּכָל לָמָּה תַבִּיט בּוֹגְדִים תַּחֲרִישׁ בְּבַלַּע רָשָׁע צַדִּיק מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: You make humanity like the fish of the sea, like creeping things with no ruler over them.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲשֶׂה אָדָם כִּדְגֵי הַיָּם כְּרֶמֶשׂ לֹא־מֹשֵׁל בּוֹ׃

verses.english: They bring all of them up with a hook, drag them in their net and gather them in their dragnet; therefore they rejoice and exult.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלֹּה בְּחַכָּה הֵעֲלָה יְגֹרֵהוּ בְחֶרְמוֹ וְיַאַסְפֵהוּ בְּמִכְמַרְתּוֹ עַל־כֵּן יִשְׂמַח וְיָגִיל׃

verses.english: Therefore they sacrifice to their net and burn incense to their dragnet, for through them their portion is rich and their food plentiful.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן יְזַבֵּחַ לְחֶרְמוֹ וִיקַטֵּר לְמִכְמַרְתּוֹ כִּי בָהֵמָּה שָׁמֵן חֶלְקוֹ וּמַאֲכָלוֹ בְּרִאָה׃

verses.english: Will they therefore keep emptying their net, continually slaughtering nations without pity?
verses.hebrew: הַעַל כֵּן יָרִיק חֶרְמוֹ וְתָמִיד לַהֲרֹג גּוֹיִם לֹא יַחְמוֹל׃

verses.english: I will stand at my watch and station myself on the rampart; I will watch to see what He will speak within me and what I shall answer concerning my complaint.
verses.hebrew: עַל־מִשְׁמַרְתִּי אֶעֱמֹדָה וְאֶתְיַצְּבָה עַל־מָצוֹר וַאֲצַפֶּה לִרְאוֹת מַה־יְדַבֶּר־בִּי וּמָה אָשִׁיב עַל־תּוֹכַחְתִּי׃

verses.english: YHWH answered me: “Write the vision and make it plain on tablets, so that the one reading it may run.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנֵנִי יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר כְּתוֹב חָזוֹן וּבָאֵר עַל־הַלֻּחוֹת לְמַעַן יָרוּץ קוֹרֵא בוֹ׃

verses.english: For the vision is still for an appointed time; it presses toward the end and will not lie. If it delays, wait for it, for it will surely come; it will not be late.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עוֹד חָזוֹן לַמּוֹעֵד וְיָפֵחַ לַקֵּץ וְלֹא יְכַזֵּב אִם־יִתְמַהְמָהּ חַכֵּה־לוֹ כִּי־בֹא יָבֹא לֹא יְאַחֵר׃

verses.english: Look, his soul is swollen, not upright within him; but the righteous one will live by his faithfulness.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עֻפְּלָה לֹא־יָשְׁרָה נַפְשׁוֹ בּוֹ וְצַדִּיק בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ יִחְיֶה׃

verses.english: Moreover, wine betrays the arrogant man, and he does not stay at home. He enlarges his appetite like Sheol and is like death, never satisfied; he gathers all nations and collects all peoples to himself.
verses.hebrew: וְאַף כִּי־הַיַּיִן בּוֹגֵד גֶּבֶר יָהִיר וְלֹא יִנְוֶה אֲשֶׁר הִרְחִיב כִּשְׁאוֹל נַפְשׁוֹ וְהוּא כַמָּוֶת וְלֹא יִשְׂבָּע וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֵלָיו כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֵלָיו כָּל־הָעַמִּים׃

verses.english: Will not all these take up a taunt against him, a mocking riddle about him, and say, “Woe to the one increasing what is not his—how long?—and loading himself with pledges!”
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא־אֵלֶּה כֻלָּם עָלָיו מָשָׁל יִשָּׂאוּ וּמְלִיצָה חִידוֹת לוֹ וְיֹאמַר הוֹי הַמַּרְבֶּה לֹּא־לוֹ עַד־מָתַי וּמַכְבִּיד עָלָיו עַבְטִיט׃

verses.english: Will not your creditors suddenly rise and your tormentors awake? You will become plunder for them.
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא פֶתַע יָקוּמוּ נֹשְׁכֶיךָ וְיִקְצוּ מְזַעְזְעֶיךָ וְהָיִיתָ לִמְשִׁסּוֹת לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: Because you plundered many nations, all the remaining peoples will plunder you, because of human bloodshed and violence against land, city and all its inhabitants.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אַתָּה שַׁלּוֹתָ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים יְשָׁלּוּךָ כָּל־יֶתֶר עַמִּים מִדְּמֵי אָדָם וַחֲמַס־אֶרֶץ קִרְיָה וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃

verses.english: Woe to the one gaining evil gain for his house, setting his nest on high to escape the hand of evil!
verses.hebrew: הוֹי בֹּצֵעַ בֶּצַע רָע לְבֵיתוֹ לָשׂוּם בַּמָּרוֹם קִנּוֹ לְהִנָּצֵל מִכַּף־רָע׃

verses.english: You planned shame for your house by cutting off many peoples and sinning against your own life.
verses.hebrew: יָעַצְתָּ בֹּשֶׁת לְבֵיתֶךָ קְצוֹת־עַמִּים רַבִּים וְחוֹטֵא נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

verses.english: For a stone will cry from the wall, and a beam from the timber will answer it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֶבֶן מִקִּיר תִּזְעָק וְכָפִיס מֵעֵץ יַעֲנֶנָּה׃

verses.english: Woe to the one building a city with bloodshed and establishing a town with injustice!
verses.hebrew: הוֹי בֹּנֶה עִיר בְּדָמִים וְכוֹנֵן קִרְיָה בְּעַוְלָה׃

verses.english: Look, is this not from YHWH of hosts: peoples labor only for fire, and nations weary themselves for nothing?
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא הִנֵּה מֵאֵת יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת וְיִיגְעוּ עַמִּים בְּדֵי־אֵשׁ וּלְאֻמִּים בְּדֵי־רִיק יִעָפוּ׃

verses.english: For the earth will be filled with knowledge of the glory of YHWH, as waters cover the sea.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תִּמָּלֵא הָאָרֶץ לָדַעַת אֶת־כְּבוֹד יְהוָה כַּמַּיִם יְכַסּוּ עַל־יָם׃

verses.english: Woe to the one making his neighbor drink, adding your fury and making him drunk, to look upon their nakedness!
verses.hebrew: הוֹי מַשְׁקֵה רֵעֵהוּ מְסַפֵּחַ חֲמָתְךָ וְאַף שַׁכֵּר לְמַעַן הַבִּיט עַל־מְעוֹרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: You are filled with shame instead of glory. Drink, you too, and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in YHWH's right hand will come round to you, and disgraceful vomit upon your glory.
verses.hebrew: שָׂבַעְתָּ קָלוֹן מִכָּבוֹד שְׁתֵה גַם־אַתָּה וְהֵעָרֵל תִּסּוֹב עָלֶיךָ כּוֹס יְמִין יְהוָה וְקִיקָלוֹן עַל־כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃

verses.english: For violence against Lebanon will cover you, and the destruction of animals will terrify them, because of human bloodshed and violence against land, city and all its inhabitants.
verses.hebrew: כִּי חֲמַס לְבָנוֹן יְכַסֶּךָּ וְשֹׁד בְּהֵמוֹת יְחִיתַן מִדְּמֵי אָדָם וַחֲמַס־אֶרֶץ קִרְיָה וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃

verses.english: What use is a carved image, that its maker carved it, a cast image and teacher of lies, that its maker trusts his own creation, making speechless idols?
verses.hebrew: מָה־הוֹעִיל פֶּסֶל כִּי פְסָלוֹ יֹצְרוֹ מַסֵּכָה וּמוֹרֶה שָּׁקֶר כִּי בָטַח יֹצֵר יִצְרוֹ עָלָיו לַעֲשׂוֹת אֱלִילִים אִלְּמִים׃

verses.english: Woe to the one saying to wood, ‘Awake!’ and to silent stone, ‘Rise!’ Can it teach? Look, it is overlaid with gold and silver, but there is no breath at all within it.
verses.hebrew: הוֹי אֹמֵר לָעֵץ הָקִיצָה עוּרִי לְאֶבֶן דּוּמָם הוּא יוֹרֶה הִנֵּה־הוּא תָּפוּשׂ זָהָב וָכֶסֶף וְכָל־רוּחַ אֵין בְּקִרְבּוֹ׃

verses.english: But YHWH is in His holy temple; be silent before Him, all the earth.”
verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה בְּהֵיכַל קָדְשׁוֹ הַס מִפָּנָיו כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth.
verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לַחֲבַקּוּק הַנָּבִיא עַל שִׁגְיֹנוֹת׃

verses.english: YHWH, I have heard the report of You; I fear. YHWH, revive Your work in the midst of the years; in the midst of the years make it known. In wrath remember mercy.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שָׁמַעְתִּי שִׁמְעֲךָ יָרֵאתִי יְהוָה פָּעָלְךָ בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים חַיֵּיהוּ בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים תּוֹדִיעַ בְּרֹגֶז רַחֵם תִּזְכּוֹר׃

verses.english: God comes from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His splendor covers the heavens, and His praise fills the earth.
verses.hebrew: אֱלוֹהַ מִתֵּימָן יָבוֹא וְקָדוֹשׁ מֵהַר־פָּארָן סֶלָה כִּסָּה שָׁמַיִם הוֹדוֹ וּתְהִלָּתוֹ מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: His radiance is like light; rays extend from His hand, and there His strength is hidden.
verses.hebrew: וְנֹגַהּ כָּאוֹר תִּהְיֶה קַרְנַיִם מִיָּדוֹ לוֹ וְשָׁם חֶבְיוֹן עֻזֹּה׃

verses.english: Before Him goes pestilence, and plague follows at His feet.
verses.hebrew: לְפָנָיו יֵלֶךְ דָּבֶר וְיֵצֵא רֶשֶׁף לְרַגְלָיו׃

verses.english: He stands and measures the earth; He looks and shakes nations loose. Ancient mountains shatter, everlasting hills sink down; His ways are everlasting.
verses.hebrew: עָמַד וַיְמֹדֶד אֶרֶץ רָאָה וַיַּתֵּר גּוֹיִם וַיִּתְפֹּצְצוּ הַרְרֵי־עַד שַׁחוּ גִּבְעוֹת עוֹלָם הֲלִיכוֹת עוֹלָם לוֹ׃

verses.english: I saw the tents of Cushan under affliction; the curtains of the land of Midian trembled.
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת אָוֶן רָאִיתִי אָהֳלֵי כוּשָׁן יִרְגְּזוּן יְרִיעוֹת אֶרֶץ מִדְיָן׃

verses.english: Was YHWH angry with the rivers? Was Your anger against rivers, or Your fury against the sea, when You rode Your horses, Your chariots of salvation?
verses.hebrew: הֲבִנְהָרִים חָרָה יְהוָה אִם בַּנְּהָרִים אַפֶּךָ אִם־בַּיָּם עֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּי תִרְכַּב עַל־סוּסֶיךָ מַרְכְּבֹתֶיךָ יְשׁוּעָה׃

verses.english: Your bow is fully bared; sworn oaths of rods—the word! Selah. You split the earth with rivers.
verses.hebrew: עֶרְיָה תֵעוֹר קַשְׁתֶּךָ שְׁבֻעוֹת מַטּוֹת אֹמֶר סֶלָה נְהָרוֹת תְּבַקַּע־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Mountains saw You and writhed; a torrent of water passed. The deep gave its voice and lifted its hands on high.
verses.hebrew: רָאוּךָ יָחִילוּ הָרִים זֶרֶם מַיִם עָבָר נָתַן תְּהוֹם קוֹלוֹ רוֹם יָדֵיהוּ נָשָׂא׃

verses.english: Sun and moon stand in their dwelling; at the light of Your arrows they move, at the brightness of Your flashing spear.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁמֶשׁ יָרֵחַ עָמַד זְבֻלָה לְאוֹר חִצֶּיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּ לְנֹגַהּ בְּרַק חֲנִיתֶךָ׃

verses.english: In indignation You march through the earth; in anger You thresh nations.
verses.hebrew: בְּזַעַם תִּצְעַד־אָרֶץ בְּאַף תָּדוּשׁ גּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: You went out for Your people's salvation, for salvation with Your anointed. You crushed the head of the wicked house, exposing its foundation up to the neck. Selah.
verses.hebrew: יָצָאתָ לְיֵשַׁע עַמֶּךָ לְיֵשַׁע אֶת־מְשִׁיחֶךָ מָחַצְתָּ רֹּאשׁ מִבֵּית רָשָׁע עָרוֹת יְסוֹד עַד־צַוָּאר סֶלָה׃

verses.english: You pierced the head of his warriors with his own rods; they stormed out to scatter me, exulting as though to devour the poor in secret.
verses.hebrew: נָקַבְתָּ בְמַטָּיו רֹאשׁ פרזו [פְּרָזָיו] יִסְעֲרוּ לַהֲפִיצֵנִי עֲלִיצֻתָם כְּמוֹ־לֶאֱכֹל עָנִי בַּמִּסְתָּר׃

verses.english: You trod the sea with Your horses, the surging of mighty waters.
verses.hebrew: דָּרַכְתָּ בַיָּם סוּסֶיךָ חֹמֶר מַיִם רַבִּים׃

verses.english: I heard, and my belly trembled; at the sound my lips quivered. Rot entered my bones, and I trembled where I stood, that I might rest on the day of distress when it comes upon the people who raid us.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמַעְתִּי וַתִּרְגַּז בִּטְנִי לְקוֹל צָלֲלוּ שְׂפָתַי יָבוֹא רָקָב בַּעֲצָמַי וְתַחְתַּי אֶרְגָּז אֲשֶׁר אָנוּחַ לְיוֹם צָרָה לַעֲלוֹת לְעַם יְגוּדֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Though the fig tree does not blossom, and there is no yield on vines; though the olive's labor fails and fields produce no food, the flock is cut off from the fold and no cattle remain in stalls,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְאֵנָה לֹא־תִפְרָח וְאֵין יְבוּל בַּגְּפָנִים כִּחֵשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה־זַיִת וּשְׁדֵמוֹת לֹא־עָשָׂה אֹכֶל גָּזַר מִמִּכְלָה צֹאן וְאֵין בָּקָר בָּרְפָתִים׃

verses.english: yet I will exult in YHWH; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בַּיהוָה אֶעְלוֹזָה אָגִילָה בֵּאלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי׃

verses.english: YHWH the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like does' feet and leads me upon my heights. For the director, with my stringed music.
verses.hebrew: יְהוִהּ אֲדֹנָי חֵילִי וַיָּשֶׂם רַגְלַי כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמוֹתַי יַדְרִכֵנִי לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינוֹתָי׃
